name: @sos-2/body-broker
description: SOS 2.0 Body Broker (Work Order P5): the broker of the Spirit/Body architecture (spec/productization-execution-architecture.md sections 1-3) — body identity (harness/provider identity is NEVER SOS semantic identity: a typed separation, spine-shaped ids rejected loudly), body registration + health lifecycle (AVAILABLE/SUSPENDED/RELEASED, release terminal), CAPABILITY-BASED body selection from declared §3 advertisements (never vendor identity — the selection inputs carry no vendor fields), and BODY LEASES with fail-closed authorization: acquire/renew/release/revoke/suspend over the durable P2 BodyLeaseRepository (@sos-2/live-store consumed verbatim — lease truth recomputed from the durable record plus the injected clock through isLeaseExpiredAt); an expired, revoked or released lease authorizes NOTHING (typed LeaseDenial, pinned by tests); renewal of a dead lease is denied. The broker may suspend, replace or release a body WITHOUT losing the task: replaceBodyLease ends the current lease and acquires a NEW single-use lease for the SAME task on a capability-selected replacement body — task identity is preserved by construction (the durable TaskRecord is the task's identity, never the body).
